'''Updating items''' refers to the tools [[Matcha Flavoured]] provides for bringing items from older versions of the pack up to date, chiefly the <code>/trigger update_item</code> command added in [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.2|1.12.2]].

== Background ==
Datapacks cannot add items, so every custom item is a vanilla item with extra data components (name, model, lore, enchantments, attributes). An item keeps the components it was created with, so when a new version changes an item's stats, textures or name, old copies stay as they were and often no longer stack with new ones. In 1.12.2 almost all models and data moved from the <code>minecraft</code> and <code>main</code> namespaces to <code>matcha</code>, which made many old items appear broken.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.2|quote=So the previous models either minecraft:x or main:x have been moved to matcha:x}}</ref>

== /trigger update_item ==
Hold the item in the main hand and run <code>/trigger update_item</code>. Any player can use it without cheats.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/update_old_items/check_trigger.mcfunction}}</ref> The function:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/update_old_items/update_held_item.mcfunction}}</ref>
# Reads the held item's ID and the translation key of its item name.
# Looks the key up in a table of 181 current item definitions, then the ID in a table of 85 more, for items whose recipe gives no item name. Both tables are generated from the pack's crafting, smithing and food recipes. An ID match replaces a key match. Items found in neither table are reported as "The held item cannot be updated."
# Builds the current version of the item, and carries over the stack size and custom name. Durability damage is kept as a proportion of the new maximum.
# Merges the old item's enchantments onto the new one; where both have an enchantment, the higher level is kept. Vanilla [[Fortune]] is then capped at level I, the pack's maximum.
# Removes the held item and drops the new one at the player's feet with no pickup delay, then reports "The held item has been successfully updated."

The tables are generated by the script <code>generate_update_item_mcfunction.py</code> in the repository.<ref>{{Source|generate_update_item_mcfunction.py}}</ref>

=== Limitations ===
In 1.12.2-beta, identifying items by ID causes wrong results. The ID table applies to every item with that ID, not only the one it was generated for, and it overrides the key table. A custom item built on one of those vanilla items is therefore rebuilt as that table entry: for example, any splash potion becomes a [[Pickled Warped Fungus|pickled warped fungus]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/update_old_items/update_held_item.mcfunction}}</ref> Armor trims and lodestone compass targets are not carried over and are lost, and items that only villagers sell, such as the [[Shepherd's Shears|shepherd's shears]], are in neither table.

The <code>main</code> branch removes the ID table, stops with the message "The held item cannot be updated because it is missing a translation key." for items without one, adds villager-trade items (234 definitions in all), and keeps armor trims and lodestone targets.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/update_old_items/update_held_item.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>

== Automatic updates ==
* The sacred texts (The Avesta, The Book of Enoch, The Divine Comedy, The Lesser Key of Solomon, Paradise Lost, The Quran and The Tanakh) and the "Golden" music disc are replaced automatically when picked up, outside Creative mode.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/update_old_items/quran.json}}</ref>
* Vanilla apples, sweet berries and turtle scutes, vanilla water bottles and unenchanted vanilla elytra are converted into the pack's versions.
* When a player joins after an update, their recipe unlocks and most progression and reward [[advancements]] are reset, so that new recipes can unlock and rewards can be earned again. In 1.12.2-beta this includes nearly the whole tutorial tab. See [[Advancements#Revocation on update]].

== Other methods ==
* <code>/loot give @s loot matcha:...</code> gives a fresh copy of many items, for example <code>matcha:treasure/divine_comedy</code>.
* Loading the previous resource pack below the new one hides broken textures, although enchantments stay broken.
* The weaponsmith (grindstone villager) melts alloyed equipment into its components, and an [[Amnestic|amnestic]] resets a villager's trades. Both were added in [[Matcha Flavoured 1.10|1.10]].
